evidence.reason: The current dependency regex still omits the stop-propagation directives. `StopPropagatedFrom=crq-tick.service` on a foreign co-tenant causes systemd to stop that co-tenant when `crq-tick.service` is stopped, and `PropagatesStopTo=` does the same in the forward direction. Because discovery does not recognize either directive, it can miss a foreign dependency that lets the live-binding fence stop an active co-tenant. Adding both alternatives to `DEPENDENCY_RE` is the smallest compatible correctness fix; no current contract clause retires this scan behavior.
